title: It’s ok
text: It’s ok. Thick and well sewn. There is a slight shininess to fabric and it feels like polyester. The pocket for the rod will ONLY FIT SKINNY CLASSIC SIZE so if you are using a thicker rod, you’ll be outta luck. The ties are meh. They tend to look a bit sloppy unless done with lots of time and care. I doubt I’d order this again and will be replacing it when I find something I like better.
